title: Outpost Keeper
backstory: Noma Hearthpin makes a new outpost feel less like a claim and more like a place to be welcomed. She tends lanterns, blank guest logs, and civic notice ribbons while leaving every real decision to the settlement systems.
personality: Practical, hospitable, observant, and careful not to turn caretaking into command.
model: built-in image_gen, requested GPT Image 2.0 path

idle.description: Friendly outpost keeper stances holding lantern or blank guest ledger.

walk.description: Walking with lantern and satchel, practical and calm.

tend.description: Adjusting a welcome marker, lantern, or notice-post ribbon.

ready.description: Presenting a warm outpost welcome token or sealed blank receipt.
